en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a central building with a clock tower, surrounded by trees and a gently sloping road. The style of the building is typical of late 19th to early 20th century Central European architecture. The text 'Karlsbad' and 'Obere Station der Drahtseilbahn' indicates this is the upper station of a funicular railway. Additional text at the bottom reads '8919 Brück & Sohn, Meissen,' indicating the publisher.
